title: 第一卷 第21章 生死战捅一剑再说第一卷 第22章 不随便的男人跟女人
content_zh:
秦逸一脚踩爆了梁百尺的命根，梁百尺发出凄厉至极的惨叫。
秦逸的眸光冰冷，手中灵剑便要斩下。
就算不能杀梁百尺，也得给他更加惨痛的教训。
“住手！”
忽然之间，一声大喝响起。
一股可怕的劲气，猛然轰来。
秦逸眉头一拧，他有一种强烈的直觉，除非将始源魔功的煞气都爆发出来，否则，抵挡不住这股劲气的冲击。
不可硬拼！
圆满层次的雷霆剑意爆发，秦逸身化惊雷，再加上有云梦儿的速度天符加持，瞬间暴退十丈之外。
秦逸避开这一股劲气之后。
一道道身影，飞掠而来，站在了秦逸的面前。
这一群人中，明显以两人为首。
一男一女。
男子身穿白色的长袍，长袍上绣有戒律二字，以及五颗星辰图案。
这是戒律堂的五星弟子。
天星武院的戒律堂，不属于七宫中的任何一宫。
戒律堂由天星武院的院长直接掌控。
戒律堂的地位极高，他们按照武院的规则，维护武院的秩序，执行武院的刑罚手段。
而这戒律堂五星男弟子的旁边，站着的则是一名天枢宫的三星女弟子。
秦逸盯着这名女子，他感觉有些眼熟，但一时之间，没想出此人是谁。

天枢宫的三星女弟子，也盯着秦逸，她的眼中流露出浓浓的恶意。
“张师兄，我们天枢宫的三个弟子，一个失去了右臂，一个失去了双臂，而梁百尺甚至连命根子都被毁了。”
“这些事，都是秦逸干的。”
“秦逸嚣张狂妄，出手狠辣，无视武院规则，所以，可以押回戒律堂处理了吧？”
张姓男子点了点头，道：“秦师妹放心，我会按照戒律堂的规矩，严肃处理秦逸！”
秦逸依旧盯着女子，道：“你也姓秦？”
女子冷笑，道：“没错，我叫秦寒霜，想起来了吗？”
秦逸的脑海中，顿时浮现了一些与秦寒霜有关的记忆。
难怪会觉得有点眼熟。
“原来是你！”
“当年，我爹还是秦家之主时，你父秦才身为秦家长老，犯下大错，被我爹严惩，你们这一脉之人，都被驱逐出了秦家祖地！”
秦寒霜的表情，顿时显得有些扭曲，道：“可你想不到吧，风水轮流转，你爹你娘出事了之后，新家主上位，将我们这一脉重新召回秦家祖地。”
“而我，也展现出了过人的天赋，成功加入了天星武院，成为了天枢宫的三星弟子。”
“秦逸，你杀害永少爷，杀害飞雪小姐，对家主不敬，你以为，躲到天璇宫就能万事大吉了？按你今日所犯之事，戒律堂完全可以废掉你的修为，将你逐出天星武院！”
“不！这事不是秦大哥的错！”云梦儿冲了出来。
她的头发凌乱，长裙破碎，面颊红肿，泛红的双眼还浮现着泪光，道：“是梁百尺他们来欺辱我，秦大哥为了救我才出剑的……”
content_en:
Qin Yi stepped on Liang Baichi's lifeblood, causing Liang Baichi to scream in agony.
Qin Yi's eyes were cold and he was about to cut off the spiritual sword in his hand.
Even if Liang Baichi couldn't be killed, he still had to teach him a more painful lesson.
"Stop!"
Suddenly, a loud shout sounded.
A terrifying energy suddenly came.
Qin Yi frowned. He had a strong intuition that unless the evil energy of the Shiyuan Demonic Art was unleashed, he would not be able to withstand the impact of this energy.
Don't fight hard!
The perfect level of Thunder Sword Intent erupted, Qin Yi turned into thunder, and with the blessing of Yun Meng'er's Speed ​​Talisman, he instantly retreated ten feet away.
After Qin Yi avoided this energy.
One after another, figures flew over and stood in front of Qin Yi.
Among this group of people, two people were obviously the leaders.
One male and one female.
The man wore a white robe with the word commandment and five stars embroidered on it.
This is a five-star disciple of the Discipline Hall.
The Discipline Hall of Tianxing Martial Academy does not belong to any of the seven palaces.
The Discipline Hall is under the direct control of the dean of the Tianxing Martial Academy.
The precepts hall has a very high status. They follow the rules of the martial arts academy, maintain the order of the martial arts academy, and execute the punishment methods of the martial arts academy.
Standing next to the five-star male disciple of the Discipline Hall was a three-star female disciple of Tianshu Palace.
Qin Yi stared at this woman. He felt a little familiar, but for a moment, he couldn't figure out who this person was.
The three-star female disciple of Tianshu Palace also stared at Qin Yi, with strong malice in her eyes.
"Senior Brother Zhang, of the three disciples of our Tianshu Palace, one has lost his right arm, one has lost both arms, and Liang Baichi has even lost his lifeblood."
"These things were all done by Qin Yi."
"Qin Yi is arrogant, ruthless, and ignores the rules of the martial arts academy. So, can he be escorted back to the Discipline Hall for processing?"
The man surnamed Zhang nodded and said: "Junior Sister Qin, don't worry, I will deal with Qin Yi seriously according to the rules of the Discipline Hall!"
Qin Yi still stared at the woman and said, "Your surname is Qin too?"
The woman sneered and said, "Yes, my name is Qin Hanshuang, do you remember it?"
Some memories related to Qin Hanshuang suddenly appeared in Qin Yi's mind.
No wonder it feels familiar.
"It turns out to be you!"
"Back then, when my father was still the head of the Qin family, your father Qin Cai, as the elder of the Qin family, made a big mistake and was severely punished by my father. People of your lineage were all expelled from the ancestral land of the Qin family!"
Qin Hanshuang's expression suddenly looked a little distorted, and he said: "But you can't imagine that things have changed. After something happened to your father and your mother, the new head of the family came to power and brought our lineage back to the ancestral land of the Qin family."
"And I also showed my extraordinary talent and successfully joined the Tianxing Martial Academy and became a three-star disciple of Tianshu Palace."
"Qin Yi, you killed Master Yong and Miss Feixue, and were disrespectful to the head of the family. Do you think everything will be fine if you hide in Tianxuan Palace? Based on what you committed today, the Discipline Hall can completely abolish your cultivation and expel you from Tianxing Martial Academy!"
"No! This matter is not Brother Qin's fault!" Yun Meng'er rushed out.
Her hair was messy, her dress was torn, her cheeks were red and swollen, and her red eyes were filled with tears. She said, "It was Liang Baichi and the others who came to bully me. Brother Qin drew the sword to save me..."
